title: Shorts: scripts waiting for review
subtitle: Tick 'approve' (voice + animation can start) or 'needs changes' for each script. Comment on details on that short's PLAN.html page (03_shorts/<folder>/PLAN.html). Showcases get the full animation first (Q16).
warning: Nothing is voiced or animated until approved here (Q17). Shorts must be 3:00 or less with pauses, so treat ~2:45 of speech as the ceiling; QWERTY (~2:47) is over it and needs a cut. Approving costs about $0.05 of TTS per short.

sections.title: Approve (voice + animation can start)
sections.intro: Showcases first (Q16). Each row: what the short says, then its open review points.

items.title: Approve: showcase: Public-key crypto with paint (crypto_paint, 14 beats, ~158 s)
items.note: Diffie-Hellman with paint: yellow + secret red / blue, Eva cannot unmix; toy numbers 5, 23 -> 2; GCHQ kept it secret until 1997.
detail: Open: U-p terms, U-q name the discrete logarithm?, U-r keep the GCHQ beat?

items.title: Approve: showcase: Friendship paradox (friendship, 13 beats, ~135 s)
items.note: 20-person network: 17 have fewer friends than their friends; Facebook 92.7%; buses feel full; flu sensors 2 weeks early; vaccinate random friends.
detail: Open: U-s term, U-t hook wording, U-u keep the μ + D/μ card?

items.title: Approve: showcase: QWERTY (qwerty, 12 beats, ~167 s)
items.note: Not made to slow typists: telegraph operators (Yasuoka), 1888 contest, 1893 standard, Dvorak's own doubtful study, Armenian phonetic layout.
detail: Open: U-v terms, U-w how the voice says QWERTY / Z / SE, U-x cut beats 5 or 10?

items.title: Approve: showcase: Stanislav Petrov (petrov, 13 beats, ~131 s)
items.note: 26 Sep 1983: 5 missiles on screen, 'not believing the computer', sun glint on clouds, the Bayes link, role debated.
detail: Open: U-y terms, U-z keep the Bayes link?, U-aa sensitivity

items.title: Approve: Bayes: the 99% test (bayes_test, 14 beats, ~150 s)
items.note: 1,000 dots: a positive means 50%, 9% for a rarer disease; gynecologists 1 in 5 right; retest, symptoms; formula card.
detail: Open: U-a address, U-b «սկրինինգ», U-c cut?, U-d HIV line

items.title: Approve: Simpson's paradox (simpson, 13 beats, ~145 s)
items.note: Kidney stones 78 vs 83 but better in both groups; Berkeley 1973; COVID Italy vs China; compare like with like.
detail: Open: U-e «ֆակուլտետ», U-f method names, U-g keep COVID?, U-h keep the exception?

items.title: Approve: Regression to the mean (regression, 14 beats, ~158 s)
items.note: Kahneman's flight instructors; 1,000 students: best 92 -> 82, worst 47 -> 59, and backwards; Galton 1886.
detail: Open: U-i term, U-j «նախատինք», U-k keep the backwards beat?, U-l trim?

items.title: Approve: Why waiting feels longer (waiting, 12 beats, ~159 s)
items.note: Houston story (told as unverified), Maister's rules, Disney's posted waits ~2/3 real, the other line wins 2 of 3 times, the snake line.
detail: Open: U-m «Մայստեր», U-n keep Houston?, U-o «ուղեբեռի ժապավեն»

items.title: Approve: Your own voice on a recording (own_voice, 12 beats, ~115 s)
items.note: Air + bone conduction; plug your ears; mirror faces (1977); own voice rated more attractive (2013).
detail: Open: U-bb terms, U-cc add a beat?

items.title: Approve: Contagious yawning (yawning, 11 beats, ~120 s)
items.note: About half catch a yawn; oxygen idea falsified; cooling theory; kin > strangers vs the 2014 null result; dogs 21 of 29.
detail: Open: U-dd «վարակվել», U-ee the comment call-to-action

items.title: Approve: Kids glued to CoComelon-style TV (kids_tv, 11 beats, ~154 s)
items.note: Orienting reflex + bright fast shows + repetition; not hypnosis (Anderson 1981); the 2011 fast-cartoon study and its limits; WHO limits; tips.
detail: Open: U-ff was CoComelon meant?, U-gg names, U-hh terms

items.title: Approve: The toothless man from Dmanisi (dmanisi, 10 beats, ~132 s)
items.note: 1.77-million-year-old toothless man near Armenia; the 'someone fed him' story vs what the bone shows; a toothless bonobo; the Mead femur quote; beautiful stories need checking.
detail: Open: U-ii keep the honest angle?, U-jj terms, U-kk credit exurb1a?

items.title: Approve: How Mashtots designed the Armenian alphabet (mashtots, 10 beats, ~2:11)
items.note: Most alphabets have no author; ours has a name, a year and a first sentence. Why Greek letters fail («ճնճղուկ»), one sound one letter, Greek order, letters as numbers; Korea and the Cherokee did the same.
detail: Open: U-ll wording, U-mm classical sentence in the voice, U-nn Korea/Cherokee extension, U-oo Georgian claim left out

items.title: Approve: Why English spelling is a mess (english_spelling, 9 beats, ~2:05)
items.note: English kids learn to read 2x slower; knight was «քնիխտ»; the Great Vowel Shift + printing froze old spellings; Latin letters added (debt, island by mistake); Armenian the opposite. English only on screen.
detail: Open: U-pp term, U-qq transliterations in the voice, U-rr «պարտք»/«կղզի»

items.title: Approve: Why the week has 7 days (week_seven, 8 beats, ~1:57)
items.note: Day, month, year come from the sky, the week does not (29.5 days); Jewish Sabbath + Roman planet days; 24 mod 7 = 3 gives the day order (a seven-pointed star); Armenian «երկուշաբթի» counts from the Sabbath; French and Soviet weeks failed.
detail: Open: U-ss ուրբաթ etymology, U-tt terms, U-uu Soviet detail

items.title: Approve: Why a minute has 60 seconds (minute_60, 8 beats, ~2:12)
items.note: Money and metres go in tens, time in sixties; Babylonian base 60 (finger-joint hypothesis); 60 divides well; Egyptian 12+12 unequal hours; «սեկունդ» = 'second small part'; French decimal time failed.
detail: Open: U-vv the Russian link, U-ww closing line too strong?

items.title: Approve: The decoy effect (medium popcorn) (decoy_popcorn, 8 beats, ~1:47)
items.note: The medium exists to sell the large; dram example; the magazine demo 84% vs 32%; comparing is easy, pricing is hard; 19 studies with real products found no effect, it holds for numbers.
detail: Open: U-xx term «խայծի էֆեկտ», U-yy Ariely on the source line, U-zz «ադիբուդի»

items.title: Approve: The IKEA effect (ikea_effect, 8 beats, ~1:38)
items.note: Builders pay 63% more for their own box; origami makers value their frogs like experts'; only if finished; effort, competence, ownership (a Munich replication); the cake-mix egg story is a legend; grandfather's crooked fence.
detail: Open: U-aaa brand in the voice, U-bbb local touch

items.title: Approve: Map projections (Greenland vs Africa) (map_projection, 8 beats, ~1:43)
items.note: Africa is 14x Greenland; drag Greenland south (smaller than Algeria), lift Armenia north (x6); orange peel and Gauss; Mercator kept angles for sailors; x4 at 60°; equal-area maps wreck shapes; Google's globe.
detail: Open: U-ccc «պրոյեկցիա» once?, U-ddd «Գուգլ քարտեզները»

items.title: Approve: Zero-knowledge proofs (zero_knowledge, 8 beats, ~1:41)
items.note: Prove a secret without revealing it: the colour-blind friend and two balls, 20 rounds = 1 in a million by luck; he still does not know which is red; age checks without a birth date, hidden crypto payments.
detail: Open: U-eee term, U-fff «դալտոնիկ», U-ggg «ռաունդ»

items.title: Approve: Greek statues were painted (painted_statues, 8 beats, ~1:44)
items.note: Paint traces under raking, UV and infrared light (Egyptian blue glows); the Peplos Kore; why we thought white (weathering, Renaissance copies, cleaning, the 1930s scraping); the copies are hypotheses.
detail: Open: U-hhh local anchor?, U-iii «Պեպլոսով կորե»

items.title: Approve: Wheeled suitcase vs backpack (luggage_wheels, 8 beats, ~1:50)
items.note: Moon before wheels; physics says zero work, yet you sweat (your body bobs and lifts the load each step); wheels let the floor carry it; the flat four-wheel case on a strap, then the pilot's upright case; why so late has no clear answer.
detail: Open: U-jjj is this the topic you meant?, U-kkk Yerevan pavement joke, U-lll «բորտուղեկցորդ»
